A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, Generalization and Memorization in Rectified Flow. All 27 pages, including equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–J, support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v2 reports original membership-inference experiments, calibration analyses, timestep-sampling experiments and Gaussian toy-data results in Section 5 and the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical results, including attack performance, generative-fidelity measurements and covariance-dependent memorization analyses.

M1.justification: The Tnaive, Tmc and Tmc_cal statistics, complexity calibration, model architectures and Symmetric Exponential timestep-sampling procedure are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use CIFAR-10, SVHN, TinyImageNet, latent-space MSCOCO and the Gaussian toy datasets in Appendix H. No dataset, task or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across the attack, compression-calibration, linearity and timestep-sampling comparisons. The newly cited parallel work is acknowledged in Section 4.2 but is not experimentally evaluated.

E3.justification: Section 5 and Appendix J retain the same splits, resolutions, training budgets, model configurations and metrics. Monte Carlo sample counts and timestep-sampling settings are also unchanged.

E4.justification: The Monte Carlo sensitivity analysis, compression-method comparisons, calibration ablations, loss-gap analysis and covariance-condition experiments are retained without revision, including all appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Figures 3 and 7 retain the same mean and standard-deviation reporting. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: The reported numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 2 retains TinyImageNet Tmc_cal AUC of 92.96% and TPR@1%FPR of 50.03%.

T1.justification: The equations, covariance assumptions, derivations and appendix proofs are unchanged. The new Section 4.2 sentence cites analytical evidence from parallel work without introducing a derivation or revising the paper's mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about calibrated membership inference, midpoint memorization and mitigation through timestep sampling. The contribution and novelty claims are not rewritten.

C2.justification: The explanations involving input complexity, nonlinearity and covariance, together with qualifications concerning latent RF and non-identity covariance, remain unchanged. The added acknowledgment attributes supporting analysis to parallel work without developing a new interpretation or limitation.

D1.justification: Hardware, training details, VAE identification, architecture specifications, dataset splits and code/checkpoint access statements are unchanged, including Tables 7–8 and Appendix A's likelihood-estimation settings.

R1.justification: v3 adds reference 41, Sesmat et al., Where flow matching leaks: Characterising the membership signals along the interpolation path. Section 4.2 newly acknowledges this as independent parallel work providing analytical evidence through irreducible variance; other citation changes are renumbering.

P1.justification: v3 adds one brief acknowledgment sentence in Section 4.2, updates the arXiv version/date stamp and renumbers affected citations. The remaining prose and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The additions cause limited spacing changes on page 11 and bibliography reflow across pages 18–19. Figures 1–8 and Tables 1–8 retain their content, captions, structure and placement.

improvement.justification: Compared with v2, v3 explicitly acknowledges relevant independent parallel research in Section 4.2 and supplies its reference, modestly improving attribution and research positioning. The scientific arguments, empirical evidence and limitations remain unchanged, so the overall benefit is limited.
